data.title: Late filing surcharge for 2023 income tax
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf sent a notice dated 27 January 2025 imposing a late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) of €75.00 because the 2023 income tax return arrived late. Payment is due within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The tax office says your 2023 income tax return was filed late and has set a late filing surcharge of €75.00. You need to pay it within one month of the notice being deemed delivered; the app shows the exact date. If you think the surcharge is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt within one month of notification. The app shows until when. If you do nothing, the amount stays due and may lead to reminders. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Relates to your 2023 income tax assessment. The late filing surcharge is generally not deductible.

key_facts.label: Late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
key_facts.quote: Nach § 152 AO wird ein Verspätungszuschlag in Höhe von 75,00 € festgesetzt.

key_facts.label: Tax year (Einkommensteuererklärung)
key_facts.quote: Ihre Einkommensteuererklärung für 2023 ist verspätet eingegangen.

items.action: Pay the €75.00 late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) to the Finanzamt.

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the issuing office.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final and can no longer be contested.
